How do I post a job?

Go to the Home screen and tap the \'+\' button or navigate to \'Post Job\' from the bottom navigation. Fill in the job details including title, description, salary, and location, then tap \'Post Job\'.
From your dashboard, tap on any posted job to see its applications. You can also go to \'My Jobs\' and select a job to view all applicants.
How do I contact an applicant?
Open the applicant\'s profile from the applications list. You can view their details and contact information to reach out directly.
How do I edit or delete a job posting?
Go to \'My Jobs\', find the job you want to modify, and tap on it. You\'ll see options to edit the job details or pause/delete the posting.
We currently support UPI, credit/debit cards, and net banking for any premium features or promoted job listings.
How do I switch to worker mode?
Go to your Profile screen and toggle the \'Switch to Worker\' option. This allows you to browse and apply for jobs as a worker.

Last updated: July 2026 • Version 2.5 • DutyPe India
Registered in India • Compliant with IT Act 2000 Section 79 & Google Play Policies

DutyPe is an instant workforce platform connecting Employers (job providers) with skilled Workers and daily-wage job seekers across India. Users must be at least 18 years of age to register. By creating an account, both Workers and Employers confirm that all profile details and qualifications supplied are accurate.
Accounts are authenticated securely via Mobile Phone OTP. Each phone number is tied to a single active role (Worker or Employer) to guarantee trust, verified ratings, and fraud prevention.

Employer job posting plans and applicant unlocks are processed through Google Play Billing (Rule 3.1 compliant). Subscriptions auto-renew via Google Play unless cancelled prior to the renewal date in Google Play settings. All payments follow standard Play Store policies.

Employers agree to post genuine job vacancies with clear pay rates, workplace locations, and duties. Employers must pay workers the agreed wages upon duty completion without unlawful deductions and ensure safe working conditions.
Workers agree to arrive on time for accepted duties, communicate professionally, and perform assigned work honestly. Zero tolerance is enforced for false attendance, harassment, or wage fraud.
DutyPe operates as an online marketplace intermediary under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act, 2000. DutyPe facilitates direct hiring connections between Workers and Employers.
DutyPe reserves the right to suspend accounts that breach terms, default on worker wage payments, post fraudulent jobs, or engage in abusive behavior.

We collect minimal information necessary for job matching: • Identity & Contact: Name, phone number, profile photo. • Profile Details: Work experience, skills, business name. • Location Data: GPS and coarse location (with explicit consent) to display nearby job postings. • Technical Data: Device OS and notification tokens.
Data is used strictly to match workers with nearby jobs, enable phone contact between hiring employers and matched workers, and dispatch duty status updates.
We NEVER sell your personal data to third parties. Data is shared exclusively between matched Employers and Workers for hiring, and stored securely on Google Firebase infrastructure.
All network traffic is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS. Local database storage uses SQLCipher device-bound encryption.
Location is used solely to calculate job proximity. Users can toggle location permissions anytime in Android System Settings.
Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to request deletion of your account and profile data anytime via the app Profile Settings or by emailing dutypein@gmail.com.
